question: In Football a direct ____ is awarded if a player commits any of the following offences against an opponent in a manner considered by the referee to be careless, reckless or using excessive force:
solution:
The correct answer is__** free-kick**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In football, a direct **free kick** is awarded if a player commits any of the following offences against an opponent in a manner considered by the referee to be careless, reckless, or using excessive force.
 
• **These offences include actions like kicking, tripping, pushing, or striking an opponent.**
 
• A **free kick** is an important concept in football. It is awarded when a player commits a foul or infringement.
 
• There are two types of free kicks:
 
 
• **Direct free kick**: A team can take a shot directly at the goal.
 
• **Indirect free kick**: The ball must touch another player before a goal can be scored.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• H**at trick**

 
 
• It refers to a player scoring **three goals** in a single match. It is a term of achievement and celebration for players, especially in football. However, it has nothing to do with the awarding of a free kick or foul.
 
 
 
• **Head Kick/Court kick**
 
 
• This is not an official term in football. However, kicking an opponent in the head, or attempting to do so, is considered dangerous play and would result in a foul.
 
• A direct free kick would be awarded for this kind of dangerous or reckless action.
